versions.subject: cisco secure firewall detections - third batch
versions.detection:
`cisco_secure_firewall` EventType=IntrusionEvent
| bin _time span=1h
| stats dc(InitiatorIP) as AffectedHosts, values(InitiatorIP) as hosts 
        min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime 
        by SignatureID, IntrusionRuleMessage Classification MitreAttackGroups InlineResult InlineResultReason 
| where AffectedHosts >= 10
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
| `cisco_secure_firewall___snort_rule_triggered_across_multiple_hosts_filter`
versions.spl: MACRO=cisco_secure_firewall EventType=IntrusionEvent | bin _time span=1h | stats dc(InitiatorIP) as AffectedHosts, values(InitiatorIP) as hosts min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime by SignatureID, IntrusionRuleMessage Classification MitreAttackGroups InlineResult InlineResultReason | where AffectedHosts >= 10 | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(firstTime) | convert timeformat="%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S" ctime(lastTime) | MACRO=cisco_secure_firewall___snort_rule_triggered_across_multiple_hosts_filter
